description: A false color infrared satellite image of the Pineiou Delta, a Natura 2000 site in Greece, captured on 2011-08-23 by Spot 5 at 2.5 m resolution, using a 1/2/3 band combination. The image depicts a coastal area featuring a large body of water on the left, rendered in bright cyan. Adjacent to the water is a strip of land covered by mottled reddish vegetation, which extends inland. Further inland, the landscape transitions into distinct, rectangular agricultural parcels, some appearing greenish-grey and others reddish-purple. Scattered white/light blue specks within these areas suggest human settlements. A yellow arrow points from the cultivated agricultural fields towards the reddish, more naturally vegetated area along the coast. This area, which displays visible parcels and drainage channels, is identified in context as being covered by grassland or scrubland, or heathland and scrub, rather than active agriculture.
